references.text: Both illustrate the principle of letting the enemy go safely and showing kindness rather than revenge.
Connects Abimelech's observation of Isaac's peace to Peter's teaching on blessing instead of repaying evil with evil.
Both warn against taking revenge by one's own hand and shedding blood without cause, pointing to God's role as the rewarder.
David asks Saul to be rewarded for sending him away in peace, just as Abimelech acknowledges Isaac's peaceful departure.
